correctness.rationale: All 21,105,105 simplices and free order-seven orbits are explicitly generated; the 3,15,15 quotient CW cells give fifteen exact oriented boundary relators. Twelve reversible generator/two-cell eliminations yield one circle and three two-cell attaching degrees -21,0,-42. Degree -42 is nullhomotopic in the degree-21 Moore complex; the two null attachments wedge on two spheres. The actual supplied pure-standard-library checker reproduces all steps; a distinct barycentric subdivision quotient Smith calculation confirms H1=Z21 and H2=Z2. Finite exhaustive enumeration is complete for this exact finite object.

value.rationale: The seven-point complete-graph matching complex is the foundational first three-torsion case, and its canonical prime seven-cycle acts freely on the entire complex. The degree-21 orbit-space fundamental group, exact attaching maps, and two-sphere wedge give a natural structural classification not entailed by known covering-complex homology or representation characters. The phenomenon combines intrinsic 3-torsion and sevenfold symmetry rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. No larger theorem is required to justify the mathematically motivated exact finite case.
